Lord '''Tellaen''' is a noble from [[Arad Doman]].

== Appearance ==
He is a portly man and wears a thin Domani mustache.

== Activities ==
He allows the [[Dragon Reborn]] and all his men to stay at his manor in Arad Doman due to Tellaen being an acquaintance of [[Davram Bashere]]. [[Rand al'Thor]] compensates him when a [[Bubble of evil]] destroys part of his manor.
